title: Burned up in the oven
text: Burned up in the oven. Not sure about the accuracy of the unit,  the oven temperature read different each time, between 25-50 degrees different. I didn't think my oven temp was off that much. What really burns me up is that it literally burned up after remaining in the oven. Maybe it wasn't supposed to stay in there but you think an oven thermometer could handle it. Well, the entire unit was black and could not be read, so I got mad and threw it out.
